chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 607: First Prisoner – A Celestial Immortal’s Power & Tragedy
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning meets a Celestial Immortal who hits harder than a True Immortal. A three-Cycle obsession shatters. One of the most tragic interrogations in Xianxia ends in an epic suicide.
og_title: A Celestial Immortal Who Hits Like a God
og_description: Ji Ning's first encounter inside the World Prison ends in tragedy and reveals a terrifying power secret.
twitter_title: Even a starved Celestial Immortal can stagger a True God in Xianxia.
twitter_description: Liangqiu's suicide is one of the most heartbreaking moments in this arc.

lore_anchors.definition: A unit of cosmological time equivalent to trillions of years; the lifespan of a universe.
The highest grade of magical weapon within the Pure Yang treasure hierarchy, used by top True Immortals and Empyrean Gods.
A distant chaosverse civilization that has been destroyed, leaving only the inhabitants of the World Prison as remnants.
An ancient, sealed prison realm holding powerful cultivators from a fallen chaosworld.
Ji Ning's top-tier divine ability, compressing his hand into an indestructible weapon capable of crushing stars.
A rare, formless power derived from will and Dao-heart, granting immense amplification to attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is a Celestial Immortal so strong in this prison?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It hints that the Ninefang Chaosworld’s cultivation system or energy density far exceeds the Three Realms’ standards.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Can Ji Ning use the two sets of flying swords?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, he plans to use them to set up a Greater Thousand Sword Formation for his Primaltwin.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Liangqiu tell Ji Ning anything?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was broken beyond reason; his only anchors were his master and princess, and their loss drove him to defiant suicide.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the wild-dog Elder God friendly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: There’s no sign yet—but Ji Ning is making a diplomatic approach with food, so expect a tense negotiation.
